rationale: Positives: The agent verified identity via full name + zip, accessed the correct account and orders, identified the Chicago address order, and correctly reported the tablet storage (64GB). Potentially acceptable: stating delivery status may have been supported by order details. Issues: 1) The agent updated the user’s default shipping address without first obtaining explicit confirmation after stating the exact change, violating the policy requirement to confirm before any write. 2) The agent provided a tracking number without an explicit tool lookup in the transcript; unless that data came from the order details, this risks being unsupported. 3) When asked to check if the package was still in transit, the agent deferred to the carrier site instead of confirming status directly, despite earlier claiming the order was delivered. The critical failure is performing an account-changing write without explicit user confirmation.
